rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial description of someone who talks a lot and likes chatting.

example.english: They’re really communicative; as soon as they sit down, they start chatting with everyone.
example.traditional: 佢真係多嘢講，一坐低就同大家吹水。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 do1 je5 gong2 jat1 co5 dai1 zau6 tung4 daai6 gaa1 ceoi1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is willing and pleasant to converse with, usually positively.

example.english: My new colleague is very communicative, and even at our first meeting they chatted happily with me.
example.traditional: 我個新同事好健談，第一次見面都同我傾到好開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 san1 tung4 si6 hou2 gin6 taam4 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 dou1 tung4 ngo5 king1 dou2 hou2 hoi1 sam1
